tutor.bio: I'm a certified language educator with 7+ years of experience helping adults gain real conversational fluency. My approach focuses on practical speaking skills — not grammar drills. I've helped 500+ students from 12 countries unlock their confidence in English and Spanish.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is the first class really free?
faq.a1: Yes! Your first 30-minute trial class is completely free. No credit card required.
faq.a2: 1:1 classes start at $25/hour. Group classes are $12/session. Packages of 5, 10, or 20 sessions save you up to 20%.
faq.a3: Just a computer or phone with a camera and internet connection. We use Zoom or Google Meet — both are free to join.
faq.a4: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule for free up to 24 hours before your class. After that, the session credit is used.
faq.a5: All levels from complete beginner (A1) to advanced (C2). We'll place you in the right class after a quick assessment.
faq.a6: Both! 1:1 classes are 60 minutes with your dedicated tutor. Group classes are 45 minutes with up to 6 students.
faq.q7: What time zones do you cover?
faq.a7: Classes are available Monday–Saturday, 8 AM–9 PM EST. All times display in your local timezone automatically.
faq.a8: Yes! We offer classes for students aged 8 and up. Please mention your child's age when booking.
